contests.title: Lee County — County Commission single-member districts

provenance.quote:
Page 1 of 1 
 
 
 
 
Lee County, Florida 
General Election, November 3, 2026 
 
 
County Charter Amendment Referendum 
 
Referendum Providing for the Structure of the County Legislative Branch 
 
Shall Chapter 2025-222, Laws of Florida, which amends the Lee County Home Rule Charter to provide that, 
beginning with the 2028 general election, the Board of County Commissioners shall be composed of five (5) 
members elected in single-member districts, become effective? 
 
Yes 
No

contests.title: Lee County — Consecutive term limits for constitutional officers

provenance.quote:
Page 1 of 1 
 
 
 
 
Lee County, Florida 
General Election, November 3, 2026 
 
County Charter Amendment Referendum 
 
County Charter Revision Relating to Setting the Number of Consecutive Terms of Elected Constitutional 
Officers  
 
County Charter Amendment Section 3.1 “Elected County Constitutional Offices”; limiting the number of 
consecutive terms of the County Constitutional Officers; amendment would limit County Constitutional Officers 
to serving no more than three (3) consecutive four-year terms in office. No previous term in office which is in 
progress as of November 2026, shall be considered a term of service for purposes of the limitations contained 
herein. 
 
Yes 
No

contests.title: Fort Myers Beach — Mandating disclosure and prohibiting unlawful gifts

provenance.quote:
Town Charter Amendment Mandating Ordinances Requiring Disclosure in Quasi-Judicial Hearings, and Prohibiting 
Unlawful Gifts  
 
Shall the Town of Fort Myers Beach Charter be amended to require the adoption of ordinances prohibiting acceptance of 
unlawful gifts, and requiring disclosure of ex parte communications in quasi-judicial proceedings, consistent with Florida law?  
 
Yes 
No

contests.title: Fort Myers Beach — Revising Town Council compensation

provenance.quote:
Town Charter Amendment Revising the Town Council Compensation Process 
 
Shall the Town Charter be amended to remove the process of annual adjustment of Town Council compensation based on 
budgeted staff compensation adjustments, and to provide that the Town Council may revise its compensation no more than 
every four years, after a 5-member Compensation Committee, appointed by the Town Council, makes recommendations for 
Town Council compensation adjustments, with adopted Town Council compensation adjustments taking effect after the next 
regular election? 
 
Yes 
No

contests.title: Fort Myers Beach — Terms of appointed Town Council members

provenance.quote:
Town Charter Amendment Revising the Term of Town Council Seats Filled by Appointment 
 
Shall the Town of Fort Myers Beach Charter be amended to provide that the term of a Town Council seat filled by appointment 
by the Town Council shall be until the expiration of the full term of the vacated seat, rather than the next regular election?  
 
Yes 
No

contests.title: Fort Myers Beach — Interim Mayor’s term of service

provenance.quote:
Town Charter Amendment Clarifying the Term of Service of the Interim Mayor 
 
Shall the Town of Fort Myers Beach Charter be amended to clarify that upon a vacancy in the council seat of the council 
member serving as Mayor, the Vice Mayor shall serve as Interim Mayor until the next annual appointment of a Mayor? 
 
Yes 
No

contests.title: Fort Myers Beach — Town Council candidate qualifying period

provenance.quote:
Town Charter Amendment Concerning the Qualifying Period for Town Council Candidates 
 
Shall the Town of Fort Myers Beach Charter be amended to clarify that the candidate qualifying period to run for Town Council 
may be determined by the Lee County Supervisor of Elections pursuant to interlocal agreement with the Town?  
 
Yes 
No

contests.title: Fort Myers Beach — Use of the Lee County Canvassing Board

provenance.quote:
Town Charter Amendment Providing for the use of the Lee County Canvassing Board  
 
Shall the Town of Fort Myers Beach Charter be amended to clarify that the Lee County Canvassing Board may canvass the 
results of any town election in accordance with state law?  
 
Yes 
No

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Makes Chapter 2025-222 effective, changing the Lee County Charter so that, beginning with the 2028 general election, the Board of County Commissioners has five members elected from single-member districts. Each district would elect its own commissioner.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve this charter change to five single-member commission districts beginning with the 2028 general election.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject making this charter change effective through this referendum.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Limits Lee County constitutional officers to three consecutive four-year terms. A term in office that is in progress as of November 2026 would not count toward this limit.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the three-consecutive-term limit with the stated exclusion for the term in progress as of November 2026.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed charter term limit.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Requires the town to adopt ordinances prohibiting unlawful gifts and requiring disclosure of communications outside the public hearing in quasi-judicial proceedings. Both requirements must be consistent with Florida law.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve these requirements for town ordinances on unlawful gifts and communications outside quasi-judicial hearings.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed Town Charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Removes annual Town Council compensation adjustments based on budgeted staff compensation changes. The council could change its compensation no more than once every four years, after recommendations from a five-member Compensation Committee appointed by the council. Any adopted change would take effect after the next regular election.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve this process and timing for changes to council compensation.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed Town Charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Changes the term for a Town Council member appointed to fill a vacancy. The appointee would serve the rest of the vacant seat’s full term, rather than only until the next regular election.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve appointed council members serving the rest of the vacant seat’s full term.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed Town Charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Clarifies that when the council seat of the member serving as mayor becomes vacant, the vice mayor serves as interim mayor until the next annual appointment of a mayor.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve this rule for how long the vice mayor serves as interim mayor after that vacancy.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed Town Charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Clarifies that the Lee County Supervisor of Elections may set the qualifying period for Town Council candidates under an interlocal agreement with the town.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve allowing the county Supervisor of Elections to set that qualifying period under an interlocal agreement.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed Town Charter amendment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Clarifies that the Lee County Canvassing Board may officially review the results of any town election in accordance with state law.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve allowing the Lee County Canvassing Board to canvass town election results under state law.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed Town Charter amendment.
